title: Bird withdraws proposal for takeover of CM.com
summary: Bird withdraws its proposed takeover of CM.com and will continue focusing on independent growth in the Netherlands. Read the full press release.
body_markdown:
**PRESS RELEASE – 30 November 2025**


This is a press release by Bird Holding B.V. ("Bird") pursuant to the provisions of Section 7, paragraph 1 sub b of the Dutch Decree on Public Takeover Bids (Besluit Openbare Biedingen Wft) (the “Decree”) in connection with the announced potential public offer (the “Offer”) for all issued and outstanding ordinary shares in the capital of CM.com N.V. ("CM.com" or the "Company"). This press release does not constitute an offer or any solicitation of any offer to buy or subscribe for any securities in the Company. This announcement is not for release, publication, or distribution, in whole or in part, in or into, directly or indirectly, any jurisdiction in which such release, publication or distribution would be unlawful, including the United States.


## Press enquiries


Any press enquiries can be made throughpress@bird.com .


## Bird withdraws proposal for takeover of CM.com


Amsterdam, the Netherlands, 30 November 2025 – Reference is made to the previous announcements dated 5 November 2025, 7 November 2025, and 12 November 2025.


In accordance with Section 7, paragraph 1 sub b of the Decree, Bird hereby announces that it will not submit a request for review and approval of an offer memorandum with the AFM. The proposal announced by Bird on 5 November 2025 has accordingly been withdrawn.


Bird is proud to be a Dutch company and the Netherlands will continue to be central to our plans. We've decided to focus on growing independently here and look forward to sharing more later ;-).


We wish CM.com continued success.


As a result of this decision, Bird will be restricted from announcing or making a public offer for CM.com during a period of six months from today, except in the event a third party announces a public offer for CM.com. To the extent permissible under applicable law, Bird may, from time to time following the date of this announcement and independently of the Offer, directly or indirectly purchase or sell, or make arrangements to purchase or sell, shares in the capital of CM.com. Any such transactions required to be made public will be disclosed by means of a press release, available on Bird's website.
